subtitle: The High Priest and the king
author: Moses Maimonides
intro: Rambam's Commentary on the Mishnah in the original 12th-century Judeo-Arabic. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a dictionary gloss.

aligned.ja: מעך. והלכה כחכמים. וקולה עדה שופטת ועדה מצלת, יעני עדה תקול זכאי והי אלמכ'לצה לה, ועדה תקול חייב והי השופטת, ולא ילזם אלקתל חתי יכון המחייבין יתר על המזכין שנים, פלזם זיאדהֵ את'נין חתי תכון עדה מצלת ועדה ושנים שופטין אעני מחייבין, אין בית דין שקול מוסיפין עוד אחד הרי שלשה, מצ'אף אלי אלשתי עדות.
aligned.en: [The opening words belong to the close of the previous chapter's commentary.] "…with you," and the law is according to the Sages. As for his statement that there is "a body that convicts and a body that acquits": the meaning is that one body declares "acquitted"—and this is the body that acquits him—and another body declares "liable"—and this is the convicting body; and the death penalty is not incurred unless those who convict exceed those who acquit by two. Hence the addition of two is required, so that there may be a body that acquits, a body of two that convicts—and since a court may not be of even number, one more is added, making three—added to the two bodies.

pairs.en: the law is according to the Sages
a body that convicts and a body that acquits
one body declares "acquitted"
another body declares "liable"
the death penalty is not incurred
those who convict exceed those who acquit by two

pairs.ja: אין בית דין שקול מוסיפין עוד אחד
pairs.en: a court may not be of even number, one more is added

aligned.ja: וקול רבנן מאה ועשרים מבין פי אלתלמוד עלהֵ הד'א אלעדד סנהדרי קטנה עשרים ושלשה, ושלש שורות של עשרים ושלשה עשרים ושלשה, ועשרה בטלנין של בית הכנסת והם אקואם לא שגל להם גיר מלאכת שמים אעני אלקראה ועמארהֵ בתי כנסיות, ושני סופרים, ושני חזנין, ושני בעלי דינין, ושני עדים, ושני זוממין, ושני זוממי זוממין, ושני גבאי צדקה, ושלשה לחלק הצדקה, ורופא אומן, ולבלר, ומלמד תינוקות, הרי מאה ועשרים.
aligned.en: As for the statement of the Rabbis that there are one hundred and twenty: it is explained in the Talmud (BT Sanhedrin 17b) that this number is reached as follows—a lesser Sanhedrin of twenty-three; three rows of twenty-three, namely sixty-nine; the ten men of leisure of the synagogue—these being people who have no occupation other than the service of Heaven, that is, study and the upkeep of synagogues; two scribes; two attendants; two litigants; two witnesses; two conspiratorial witnesses; two who refute the conspiratorial witnesses; two collectors of charity; three for the distribution of charity; a skilled physician; a notary; and a teacher of children—thus one hundred and twenty.

pairs.en: one hundred and twenty
a lesser Sanhedrin of twenty-three
the ten men of leisure of the synagogue

pairs.ja: מלאכת שמים אעני אלקראה ועמארהֵ בתי כנסיות
pairs.en: the service of Heaven, that is, study and the upkeep of synagogues
two conspiratorial witnesses; two who refute the conspiratorial witnesses
three for the distribution of charity
a teacher of children

aligned.ja: ור' נחמיה יקול אן אקל אלמקדמין רתבה שרי עשרות ות'לאת'ה ועשרין דיין הם שרי עשרות למאתין ות'לאתין. ואין הלכה כר' נחמיה. פרק. שני.
aligned.en: R. Nehemiah holds that the lowest rank among those appointed is the officers of tens, and that twenty-three judges are officers of tens over two hundred and thirty men. And the law is not according to R. Nehemiah.

pairs.en: R. Nehemiah holds
officers of tens
twenty-three judges
the law is not according to R. Nehemiah

aligned.ja: משנה [א]
aligned.en: Mishnah 1

aligned.ja: קולה מעיד, ליס כל שהאדה אתפקת, בל שהאדה תכ'תץ באלסלטאן פקט לעט'ם דרג'תה.
aligned.en: His statement "testifies": not every form of testimony is meant, but rather testimony that pertains to the sovereign alone, on account of the eminence of his rank.

pairs.en: His statement "testifies"
testimony that pertains to the sovereign
the eminence of his rank

aligned.ja: וקולה הן נכסין והוא נגלה, מענאה לא ימשי מכ'תלט מע אלנאס בל יתקדמון אמאמה יחג'בונה והו וחדה מתמיז בינהם.
aligned.en: His statement "they are hidden and he is revealed" means that he does not walk mingled among the people; rather, they go before him and screen him off, and he alone is set apart in their midst.

pairs.en: they are hidden and he is revealed
he does not walk mingled among the people
they go before him and screen him off
he alone is set apart in their midst

aligned.ja: ועלהֵ קול ר' יהודה אנה יקול בלהף אלמות קד יקרב מנה ויגע במת. ור' מאיר יקול לעט'ם דרג'תה ואלנאס כלהם נאט'רין אליה לא יתרך לד'לך. והלכה כר' יהודה.
aligned.en: Upon this turns the view of R. Yehuda, who holds that, out of the anguish of mourning, death may draw near to him and he may contract corpse-impurity. R. Meir holds that, on account of the eminence of his rank—since all the people gaze upon him—he is not permitted to do this. And the law is according to R. Yehuda.

pairs.en: the view of R. Yehuda
the anguish of mourning
contract corpse-impurity
R. Meir holds that, on account of the eminence of his rank
all the people gaze upon him
the law is according to R. Yehuda

aligned.ja: משנה [ב]
aligned.en: Mishnah 2

aligned.ja: אלד'י יקול הו לאלנאס אד'א עאזאהם תנוחמו.
aligned.en: The one who speaks to the people when he comforts them says "be consoled."

pairs.en: The one who speaks to the people

aligned.ja: ושרח מברין, יפטרונה. וספסל, כרסי צגיר.
aligned.en: The explanation of "mavrin" is that they provide him the mourner's meal. And "sofsel" is a small chair.

pairs.en: The explanation of "mavrin"
they provide him the mourner's meal
"sofsel" is a small chair

aligned.ja: משנה [ג]
aligned.en: Mishnah 3

aligned.ja: הד'א פי מלכי ישראל פקט לכונהם מתעדיין עלי אלמלך לא יות'רון אלאנכ'פאץ' ואלתואצ'ע ולא יחתמלון אלחק, אמא מלכי בית דוד דנין ודנין אותם לאנהם עארפין באלחק ולא יעט'ם עליהם אלתואצ'ע, לאן מלכהם שרעי לא ינקצה תואצ'עהם.
aligned.en: This applies only to the kings of Israel, since they transgressed against [the proper conduct of] kingship: they do not prefer humility and lowliness, nor do they bear with the demands of justice. The kings of the House of David, however, both judge and are judged, for they are versed in justice, and humility is no burden upon them—for their kingship is legitimate and their humility does not diminish it.

pairs.en: only to the kings of Israel
they do not prefer humility and lowliness
nor do they bear with the demands of justice
their kingship is legitimate and their humility does not diminish it

aligned.ja: קאל בית דוד כה אמר ה' דינו לבקר משפט, ודוד עליה אלסלאם כאן מן ג'מלהֵ סנהדרי גדולה.
aligned.en: Concerning the House of David Scripture says, "Thus says the LORD: Execute justice in the morning" (Jeremiah 21:12); and David, peace be upon him, was himself among the members of the Great Sanhedrin.

pairs.ja: בית דוד כה אמר ה' דינו לבקר משפט
pairs.en: "Thus says the LORD: Execute justice in the morning"
David, peace be upon him
the Great Sanhedrin

aligned.ja: והלכה כר' יהודה פי קולה נושא הוא המלך אלמנתו של מלך, אמא חליצה ויבום פלא יסמע מנה לאן ד'לך הואן בה וירקה בפניו, ומן חית' אמתנעת אלחליצה אמתנע אליבום, ומן אצולנא מלך שמחל על כבודו אין כבודו מחול, פלד'לך אין שומעין לו.
aligned.en: The law is according to R. Yehuda in his statement that "the king performs the rite of levirate refusal," [meaning the case of] the widow of a king; but as for levirate refusal and levirate marriage [where he himself would be a party], one does not heed him, for that would be a degradation to him—"and she spits in his face" (Deuteronomy 25:9)—and inasmuch as the refusal-rite is barred to him, levirate marriage too is barred. And it is a principle of ours that "a king who forgoes the honor due him—his honor is not forgone"; therefore one does not heed him.

pairs.en: The law is according to R. Yehuda

pairs.ja: נושא הוא המלך אלמנתו של מלך
pairs.en: "the king performs the rite of levirate refusal," [meaning the case of] the widow of a king
levirate refusal and levirate marriage
that would be a degradation to him

pairs.ja: מלך שמחל על כבודו אין כבודו מחול
pairs.en: "a king who forgoes the honor due him—his honor is not forgone"
one does not heed him

aligned.ja: ושרח פלטורין שלו קצרה. לפייס, לידארי אלנאס ויעלמהם אנה לם יכן לה גרץ' פי קתלה. ודרגש, מן אנואע אלכראסי ואלאסרה והו אכבר מן ספסל. ואין הלכה כר' יהודה.
aligned.en: The explanation of "his palatial chambers" is "his hall." "To appease": to placate the people and make known to them that he had no personal stake in his execution. And "dargash" is a kind of chair or couch, larger than a "sofsel." And the law is not according to R. Yehuda.

pairs.en: "To appease": to placate the people

pairs.ja: לם יכן לה גרץ' פי קתלה
pairs.en: he had no personal stake in his execution
"dargash" is a kind of chair or couch
the law is not according to R. Yehuda

aligned.ja: משנה [ד]
aligned.en: Mishnah 4

aligned.ja: מלחמת הרשות, קתאל סאיר אלמלל גיר שבעה עממין ומלחמת עמלק כמא בינא פי אלת'אמן מן שוטה. ומן שרוט מלחמת הרשות אן לא תכון אלא במלך וסנהדרין.
aligned.en: "Optional war" is warfare against the rest of the nations, other than the seven nations and the war against Amalek, as we explained in the eighth chapter of Sotah. Among the conditions of optional war is that it may be undertaken only by a king and a Sanhedrin.

pairs.en: "Optional war"

pairs.ja: קתאל סאיר אלמלל גיר שבעה עממין
pairs.en: warfare against the rest of the nations, other than the seven nations

pairs.ja: כמא בינא פי אלת'אמן מן שוטה
pairs.en: as we explained in the eighth chapter of Sotah
the conditions of optional war
it may be undertaken only by a king and a Sanhedrin

aligned.ja: ושרח אין ממחין, אנה לא יעתרץ'. וחלק בראש, הו אן יאכ'ד' נצף ג'מיע מא סלב אלנאס מצ'אף אלי מא כאן ענד ד'לך אלסלטאן אלגוי לאן מאל אלסלטאן לאלסלטאן.
aligned.en: The explanation of "none may protest" is that one may not object. And "he takes a portion at the head" means that he takes half of all the spoil plundered from the people, in addition to whatever belonged to that gentile ruler—for the property of the ruler belongs to [the conquering] sovereign.

pairs.en: The explanation of "none may protest"
one may not object
"he takes a portion at the head"
half of all the spoil plundered from the people
the property of the ruler belongs to [the conquering] sovereign

aligned.ja: משנה [ה]
aligned.en: Mishnah 5

aligned.ja: יג'וז לאלמלך אן יכת'ר מן אלכ'יל מא שא לרכוב אלעסאכר ויכת'ר איצ'א פי אלכ'יל פי מחלתה כי ידהש אלעדו, ואנמא חרם אללה עליה אן תכון ענדה כ'יל עטאלה פי אלאסטבלאת מעדה לרכובה יומא מא או תקאד בין ידיה מת'ל מא יפעל מלוך אלמלל, בל לא יג'וז לה אן יכון ענדה גיר פרס ואחד
aligned.en: It is permitted for the king to multiply as many horses as he wishes for mounting the armies, and likewise to increase the horses in his camp in order to overawe the enemy. God prohibited to him only that he keep idle horses in the stables, set aside for him to ride on some occasion or to be led before him in the manner of the kings of the nations; rather, it is not permitted to him to keep more than a single horse

pairs.ja: יג'וז לאלמלך אן יכת'ר מן אלכ'יל
pairs.en: It is permitted for the king to multiply as many horses
for mounting the armies
in order to overawe the enemy
idle horses in the stables
in the manner of the kings of the nations

pairs.ja: לא יג'וז לה אן יכון ענדה גיר פרס ואחד
pairs.en: it is not permitted to him to keep more than a single horse
